WITH telescope_averages AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate
  FROM signals
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescref
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate
  FROM signals
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
),
above_overall AS (
  SELECT ta.telescref, ta.avg_pulse_rate, oa.avg_pulse_rate AS overall_avg
  FROM telescope_averages ta
  CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
  WHERE ta.avg_pulse_rate > oa.avg_pulse_rate
),
second_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_pulse_rate
  FROM above_overall
)
SELECT
  AVG(ao.avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_average_pulse_rate,
  AVG(ao.avg_pulse_rate - ao.overall_avg) AS mean_above_overall_average,
  AVG(ao.avg_pulse_rate - sa.avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_above_second_average
FROM above_overall ao
CROSS JOIN second_average sa
WHERE ao.avg_pulse_rate > sa.avg_pulse_rate
